misconceptionSafeguards: Energy propagation and water displacement are distinct. No ocean-water path or subterranean channel from Russia to Nevada.
Distant forcing is represented by qualitative seismic surface-motion cues; no ray through Earth’s core, calibrated travel speed or human-perceptible shaking at the cave.
Date context is July29 Nevada/UTC, July30 Kamchatka local. No invented exact cave-arrival timestamp from a rounded interval.
Ten inches is a reported event value with unspecified height convention. No universal seiche size, metre-scale July wave or magnitude-equals-local-intensity claim.
Shelf dependence and limited July material loss are distinct from previous disturbances, extinction risk estimates and current population.
NPS before/after frames bear July14 and July30; not adjacent observations, a mortality test or a measured removal ratio.
An ocean tsunami can also have been generated by this earthquake; its existence does not make the cave waves a tsunami.
All new illustrations must identify schematic geometry/motion and reconstruction; source photos are consultation-only.
comprehensionReview: First frame links a recognizable dry-rock pool to a distant earthquake without waiting for generic establishing footage. Event numbers appear sequentially. Existing water remains continuous as ground motion is separated and translated into rocking. The term seiche follows the visual causal explanation; the feeding shelf becomes meaningful only afterward. Ending resolves the connected-Earth idea. Actual first-frame clarity, caption density and pacing need future rendered review; no audience panel conducted.
rightsReview: Original geographic/cave/shelf illustrations selected conceptually. Three NPS-credited reference photos were inspected ephemerally under the published government-work policy, with asset URLs/hashes/credits retained; none imported for production. No monitoring video viewed or audio copied, no protected logo or source image selected. Established Manrope and af_heart remain proposed; record licenses and canonical identities for actual future assets when authorized.

careAssessment.rationale: Historical geophysical explanation with inspected operator evidence and corroborating scientific-agency mechanisms/catalog. No medical advice, exceptional cost, rights exception or brand deviation. Unselected exact resonance and exaggerated impact claims are excluded from the artifact.
